name: Wren
line: A little origami bird, cream on one side and terracotta on the other. Turns to face you, carries your notes.
author: hey-claude

antics.name: Goes fishing off the edge
antics.exit: drops the rod, which tumbles away, and snaps to attention

antics.name: Preens under its wing
antics.exit: head flips back to the front, startled

antics.name: Folds itself into a boat
antics.exit: pops back into a bird; the little waves fade

antics.name: A paper-airplane flight
antics.exit: back on its perch in a blink, a streak of trail behind

antics.name: Reads a tiny folded letter
antics.exit: the letter snaps shut and flutters down

antics.name: Folds a paper crane
antics.exit: the half-folded paper flops flat and fades

antics.name: Catches a falling leaf
antics.exit: the leaf slips away and spins down

antics.name: Shelters under a paper umbrella
antics.exit: the umbrella snaps shut with a shower of drops

antics.name: Hops along and back
antics.exit: skids to a stop in a puff of dust

antics.name: Stamps a postmark
antics.exit: the envelope whisks away off the edge

antics.name: A gust ruffles its folds
antics.exit: the wind drops; folds snap flat
